text: ABUS August Bremicker Söhne KG, the lock and bicycle security and helmet maker based in Wetter an der Ruhr, is 100 percent owned by the Bremicker family.
short: ABUS is 100% owned by the Bremicker family.

source.name: IHK Weltmarktführer Südwestfalen: ABUS company profile
source.quote: ABUS August Bremicker Söhne KG and its subsidiaries are 100 percent owned by the Bremicker family.
